firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'Stack the first cord in September' states trade+city+outcome in 6 words; primary CTA 'Price a visit' + quieter 'Call'; phone visible in header; proof line present; season rail peeks ~60px. 390-first.jpg: h1 4 lines, both CTAs above fold; phone hidden in header but sticky bar provides it immediately.

distinctiveness.notes: Season-rail signature in hero (1440-first.jpg), sticky sub-nav (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-50.jpg), watermark numerals behind section kickers, and footer signoff — ≥4 sections. Offset-frame hero family unique vs siblings A (arch) and B (document). Maple+birch palette and Sora/DM Sans pair differ from A and B.

type.notes: Sora display + DM Sans text from catalog; fluid scale; body ≥16px at full ink; measure ~68ch; tabular numerals in prices/hours/phone; lead paragraph set apart; ≤5 sizes; no orphans; display tracking -0.02em. Visible across 1440-full.jpg and 390-full.jpg.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 11 sections each with one job; ≥3 layout families (hero split, split-stack, rail-layout, statement-layout, grid cards); alternating tones. Round 0 fix added full-bleed t-accent season-band divider between July and Services, breaking previous t-paper/t-paper adjacency. Tonal rhythm now paper→mid→deep→accent→paper→mid→paper→deep. No two adjacent bands share tone.

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg and scroll frames: all photos on-topic (woodshed, roof rods, stove install, chimney cap, flue brush); consistent warm grade with sepia(0.1) filter; object-position on thirds; alt text describes frame; video has poster and preload. Stock ceiling applies; no art-directed sequence beyond offset-frame hero.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: voice matches concept's three sentences; every section answers one homeowner question from brief §1; microcopy under form button; Sample labels on every review card, every price row, and price table caption. No banned phrases or tricolons.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg and 390-full.jpg: composed phone layout, sticky call bar works and hides on scroll down, tap targets ≥48px, h1 ≤4 lines. qa/render.json: zero overflow errors at 390px and 320px (scrollWidth equals viewport). Header call button hidden below 640px, menu-btn constrained. Upgraded from 8.0 after round 0 fix.

a11y.notes: qa/static.json and qa/render.json: zero blockers/warnings. 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg: all content visible, no hidden text, season rail static. Skip link present; focus visible (2px outline, 3px offset); all inputs labeled; heading order correct (one h1, h2 per section).

motion.notes: 1440-first.jpg through 1440-scroll-75.jpg: tidy intro (rail slides, watermark fades, photo unclips); ≥3 hooks (rail slide, frame unclip, staggered cards); reduced motion respected; hover hairline scaleX. Entrance variety is 3 patterns, not 4+, preventing 9.0.

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: season-rail-as-navigation tied to thesis; firewood dry-check outputs seasonal answer in signature's ruled-card language. Sweep interval planner output is plain text, not visually integrated into the rail signature (-0.5 from 10 anchor).

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon; OG 1200x630; theme-color #1c1816; JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness; print stylesheet; lazy images with width/height; hero poster preloaded; forced colors handled; consistent 2px radius; designed footer with signoff, biz, disclaimer, credits.

elevate.move: Add a quiet breath section (t-paper, minimal type, no image) between the dense tools section and the reviews band to create a loud→dense→quiet→dense cadence visible in the full-page screenshot.
Add a fourth entrance pattern: a horizontal wipe reveal on the season-rail watermark numerals as each section enters, tying the signature element to the motion system and pushing motion toward 9.0.
